description: Automated dependency update PRs (ADR 0018). Images are pinned by digest; where a file cannot carry tag@digest (compose.yaml, because podlet rejects it), the version sits in a trailing comment, which the custom managers below keep in step.

customManagers.description: Digest-pinned images with the version in a trailing comment: compose.yaml, scripts, git hooks
tag@digest images held in shell variables and Containerfile ARGs

packageRules.description: Image pins are copied into generated files that Renovate cannot regenerate: the reviewer runs the scripts on the branch (ADR 0018)
prBodyNotes:
**Before merging:** this PR changes an image pin, which `deploy/quadlet/` and `apps/api/src/system/inventory.ts` carry too. Their drift checks in `scripts/ci.sh` fail until they are regenerated on this branch:

```bash
scripts/quadlet.sh && scripts/inventory.sh
```

Commit the result to this branch. Renovate then stops rebasing it; to start over, tick the rebase checkbox, which discards the commit.
